maps.spawns: CT Spawn far west, T Spawn far east; both sites are on the CT half but CT Spawn opens to the south, so CTs walk round to A via the Truck lane and to B via Tree Room. Estimated minimum run times (shortest line across the CS2 nav mesh from the spawn-zone centre to the edge of the plant zone; knife 250 u/s to AK 215 u/s; real runs are a little slower, and a nav-area-centre route gave values up to about 30% higher): CT to A about 8.5-10 s, CT to B about 8.5-10 s; T to A about 16-18.5 s, T to B about 14-16 s; A to B about 12-14 s. Secondary sources report a 9-10 Sep 2026 update that restored a missing competitive CT spawn and added T spawn points.

modeTips.t: Default: take Mid with Valve's 'White Box' smoke from Garage and the 'Connector' smoke from the yard north of Garage, keep one player near Squeaky/A Main and one in B Halls for information. A execute: Valve 'Cross' smoke from the Long A hall to block the Truck/Highway side, smoke Highway if Mid is yours, molotov Quad and Forklift, flash over the A Main exit and hit through A Main with a Squeaky player joining. B execute: from Sun Room throw Valve's 'Tree' and 'Heaven' smokes, smoke Checkers if a Mid player is there, molotov Headshot or Back of Site, flash over B Main and enter together; plant default or behind default.
modeTips.ct: Typical 2-1-2: two A (one Truck or Quad, one Highway or an A Main peek), one Mid player at Z Connector or Highway (often the AWP) who rotates to either site, two B (one Heaven, one Headshot/Tree Room or Checkers). Spend molotovs on A Main and B Main to buy time; rotations from CT Spawn are long on this layout, so call early. The Mid player decides many rounds: losing Z lets Ts split through Highway and Checkers.
modeTips.pistol: T: fast B Main with flashes, or a Mid take into a Highway or Checkers split. CT: stack the likely site with three, keep the Mid player alive for information and save flashes for the retake.
modeTips.retake: A: smoke A Main from the Truck (Valve lineup), come from the Truck lane and Highway together, flash over, clear Quad, Forklift, Toxic and the catwalk. B: Tree Room, Heaven stairs and Checkers at the same time; Valve 'B Main' smoke from Heaven, clear Hell, Headshot and Back of Site before the defuse.
modeTips.postplant: A plant: hold from A Main, the Long A side and Forklift/Quad, with one player in Mid or Squeaky to catch Highway rotators. B plant: hold from B Main, the Sun Room window and one hidden spot; keep a molotov for the default plant.

maps.weaponFit: AWP: Z Connector or Highway for Mid, Heaven for B Main, Truck or Quad for A Main; T AWP from Garage into Mid. Rifles: site holds on A and B and the Mid fight. SMGs and shotguns: close spots such as Hell, Headshot, Forklift, Squeaky and Checkers; good on CT force buys. Molotovs on A Main and B Main are the main delay tool.
mistakes: Crossing Mid without the White Box and Connector smokes
Ignoring Squeaky, so Ts join A Main from Mid unseen
Peeking Heaven from B Main without a smoke or flash
Planting A before clearing Quad, Forklift and Toxic
CT Mid player dying early and leaving Highway and Checkers open
Rotating late: CT Spawn is a long walk from both sites on the 2026 layout
Playing old CS:GO angles such as the Z ladder, which is reported removed in CS2 Cache
Leaving Sun Room free so Ts throw utility through the window without pressure

searchAndDestroy.A notes: Open yard top-left: Quad at the back, a blue door in the north wall, Forklift by the A Main exit, the Truck lane to the west, Toxic and a raised catwalk on the south edge. Ts enter from A Main (fed by Long A and Squeaky); CTs from the Truck lane and Highway. Plants named in Valve's retake file: default, 'for A Main', 'green crate', 'highway/truck', 'middle of site'. Retake from the Truck and Highway at the same time; Valve's CT 'A Main' smoke from the Truck cuts T support; flash over and clear Quad, Forklift, Toxic and the catwalk.
searchAndDestroy.B notes: Bottom-left site with crates; Headshot and Back of Site on the west side, Heaven (raised, by stairs) and Hell beneath it on the north, Tree Room to the west and Checkers to the north. Ts enter from B Main with Sun Room support; CTs from Tree Room, Heaven and Checkers. Plants in Valve's retake file: default, 'behind default', 'back site', 'top of ramp'. Retake through Tree Room, Heaven and Checkers together; Valve's 'B Main' smoke from Heaven cuts the T post-plant from B Main.

utilityPlans.name: A execute from A Main
utilityPlans.how: Throw the Highway, Cross and back of A smokes from outside A Main. Burn Forklift as the smokes bloom, then pop the A Main flash and run out together.

utilityPlans.name: B execute through B Main
utilityPlans.how: From Sun Room, smoke Heaven, Tree and the CT entrance. Damage the back of site, burn Headshot and New Box, then enter B as a group.

utilityPlans.name: Mid take
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Connector from spawn, then throw the White Box and Left Mid smokes from Garage. Burn Sandbags and push Mid to split A or B.

utilityPlans.name: Retake A
utilityPlans.how: Smoke A Main from Truck or Quad to stop Ts rotating in. Retake from Truck and Highway together, trading the first fight.

utilityPlans.name: Retake B
utilityPlans.how: Smoke B Main from Heaven so late Ts cannot join the site. Retake from Checkers and Heaven at the same time. No retake flash had a source.

maps.name: Dust II
maps.setting: Sun-baked North African style town: sandstone walls, wooden double doors, blue and teal trims, crates and market clutter under bright sunlight. The CS2 version is a Source 2 rebuild of the 2017 Dust II with brighter lighting and cleaner textures. Active Duty since CS2 launch.
maps.layout: Three-lane map. On the official radar T Spawn is bottom centre and CT Spawn top centre-right. A site is top-right, reached by Long A (right edge, via Long Doors and Pit) and by Catwalk/Short from Mid. B site is top-left, reached by Upper Tunnels from the left side. Mid runs straight up the centre from Top of Mid to Mid Doors; Lower Tunnels links the T side of Mid Doors to Upper Tunnels. CTs reach B through CT Mid and B Doors.

callouts.name: T Spawn
callouts.look: Open sandy yard at the bottom of the radar with sandstone walls, wooden crates and a slope rising to the right.
callouts.use: Ts start here. Exits: right via T Ramp to Outside Long, up Suicide into Top of Mid, left to Outside Tunnels. A T AWP can look up Mid towards Mid Doors from near here.

callouts.name: T Ramp
callouts.look: Sloped sandy path leading right and up from T Spawn, between sandstone walls.
callouts.use: Fastest T path toward Outside Long and Long Doors. Official in-game place name 'T Ramp'.

callouts.name: Outside Long
callouts.look: Open sandy area in front of the big wooden Long Doors, walls on both sides, a corner by the doors.
callouts.use: T staging spot before Long. Ts throw the Long cross smoke and flashes from here; aggressive CTs sometimes peek through the door gap early.

callouts.name: Long Doors
callouts.look: Large wooden double doors set in a sandstone arch. A gap between the door leaves gives a thin view through.
callouts.use: Main choke to Long A. CTs hold the exit from Pit, A Car and Long Corner; Ts smoke the far side and flash before running through. Valve ships a CT smoke lineup that lands here.

callouts.name: Blue
callouts.look: Large blue rubbish container just past Long Doors on the Long side.
callouts.use: First cover for Ts after the doors and the spot Valve's 'A Cross' smoke is thrown from (stand at the end of the blue trash). CTs pre-aim its edges from Pit and Long.

callouts.name: Pit
callouts.look: Sunken dirt hollow at the right edge below Long's lane, with steps and a raised ledge beside it.
callouts.use: CT off-angle that watches Ts coming out of Long Doors. Strong for an AWP or rifle, but slow to leave once Ts flash and push: a teammate must cover the retreat.

callouts.name: Long A
callouts.look: Wide, open sandy lane up the right side of the map from the doors area to A Ramp; long sightlines and few boxes.
callouts.use: Main rifle and AWP lane to A. Ts need a cross smoke or flashes to cross; CTs fall back to A Car and site when outnumbered.

callouts.name: A Car
callouts.look: Parked car at the top of Long near A Ramp, beside the wall.
callouts.use: CT cover to hold Long from close range and a T post-plant spot facing Long Doors. Often grouped with 'Long Corner' in calls.

callouts.name: A Ramp
callouts.look: Short slope from the top of Long up onto the A platform.
callouts.use: Last step from Long onto site. CTs on site, Goose and CT Spawn pre-aim it; Ts flash over it before peeking.

callouts.name: A Site
callouts.look: Raised sandstone platform in the top-right with stacked wooden crates (default boxes); open to Short on the left and Ramp on the right.
callouts.use: Bomb site A. Default plant beside the crates; Ts plant behind boxes to hide the bomb from Long or from Short.

callouts.name: Goose
callouts.look: Back-right corner of A behind the site crates, tucked against the wall.
callouts.use: CT off-angle covering Ramp and site; T post-plant hide spot. Clear it with a molotov or HE before you defuse or plant.

callouts.name: Short
callouts.look: Raised stone walkway with a low wall and railing that comes out on the left side of A from the Catwalk.
callouts.use: Second T route into A from Mid. CTs on site and near CT Spawn hold its exit; Ts smoke CT Spawn and flash over the wall before pushing.

callouts.name: Short Stairs
callouts.look: Stone stairs from the end of Catwalk up to Short, next to a wall.
callouts.use: T climb to Short; CTs throw molotovs here to slow a Short push. Official place name 'Short Stairs'.

callouts.name: Catwalk
callouts.look: Long raised ledge running from the top of the Xbox in Mid to Short Stairs, with a low wall facing Mid.
callouts.use: T route from Mid to A. CT Mid players and a CT Spawn AWP watch it; Valve's 'CT' smoke is thrown from here to block CT Spawn.

callouts.name: Xbox
callouts.look: Large square crate in Mid below the start of Catwalk; you can jump on it to reach Cat.
callouts.use: Ts' climb onto Catwalk and the target of the T-spawn 'Xbox' smoke that blocks the Mid Doors AWP while Ts cross.

callouts.name: Mid
callouts.look: Long, straight sandy lane down the centre between high sandstone walls, from Top of Mid to Mid Doors.
callouts.use: Central lane and the classic AWP duel. Whoever wins Mid can split to A Short, B via Mid Doors or Lower Tunnels.

callouts.name: Top of Mid
callouts.look: Open junction at the T end of Mid where Suicide, the path to Outside Long and Mid meet.
callouts.use: T entry to Mid; exposed to the Mid Doors AWP. Cross behind a smoke or jump-peek; also links to Outside Long.

callouts.name: Suicide
callouts.look: Steep sandy slope from T Spawn up into Top of Mid, in a straight line with Mid Doors.
callouts.use: Fast way into Mid for Ts but in full view of a CT AWP at Mid Doors, hence the name. Walk up only with a smoke or a plan.

callouts.name: Mid Doors
callouts.look: Pair of large wooden doors at the CT end of Mid with a narrow gap between them.
callouts.use: CT AWP spot looking down Mid through the gap and the link between Mid, Lower Tunnels and CT Mid. Ts smoke it ('Mid CT' smoke) to cross.

callouts.name: CT Mid
callouts.look: Open area beyond Mid Doors, between the slope up to CT Spawn and the passage to B Doors.
callouts.use: CT rotation hub between A and B. Ts who break Mid can split from here to B Doors or towards CT Spawn.

callouts.name: CT Spawn
callouts.look: Sandstone plaza near the top centre-right of the radar with steps down toward CT Mid and a short path right to A.
callouts.use: CTs start here, a few seconds from A. Ts smoke it before pushing Short; Valve's 'CT' smoke lineup from Catwalk lands here.

callouts.name: B Doors
callouts.look: Wooden double doors on the right side of B site, opening from the CT Mid side; a broken window/gap beside them.
callouts.use: CT route into B and a key smoke target on B executes (Valve lineup from Outside Tunnels). CTs flash through here on retakes.

callouts.name: B Site
callouts.look: Walled courtyard in the top-left with stacked crates, a raised back platform, a wrecked car and the tunnel exit at the bottom.
callouts.use: Bomb site B. Ts enter from Upper Tunnels, CTs from B Doors. Default plant in the open by the boxes.

callouts.name: Back Plat
callouts.look: Raised platform at the back-left of B with pillars and crates.
callouts.use: CT hold watching Tunnels and Doors; T post-plant spot. Official place name 'B Platform'.

callouts.name: B Car
callouts.look: Wrecked car in front of the tunnel exit at the bottom of B.
callouts.use: Close-range CT hide spot and T post-plant cover from B Doors.

callouts.name: Upper Tunnels
callouts.look: Dark, enclosed stone corridors on the left side with wooden beams, leading north to the B tunnel exit.
callouts.use: T route to B and the stack point before a B execute. CTs push it early with a flash for information.

callouts.name: Tunnel Stairs
callouts.look: Short curved stairway joining Lower Tunnels to Upper Tunnels.
callouts.use: Link between Mid and B; lurkers wait here to catch CTs rotating through Lower.

callouts.name: Lower Tunnels
callouts.look: Low, dim tunnel running from the T side of Mid Doors to the tunnel stairs.
callouts.use: T connector from Mid to B and to Mid Doors. CTs peek it from Mid Doors; Ts hold it to support a B or Mid split.

callouts.name: Outside Tunnels
callouts.look: Open sandy area left of T Spawn in front of the tunnel entrance, with crates and a corner.
callouts.use: T path into Upper Tunnels. Valve's 'B Doors' smoke is thrown from the corner by the trash here.

powerPositions.why: AWP through the door gap sees the whole length of Mid, Top of Mid and Suicide; one pick here slows every T mid play.
powerPositions.counter: Throw the T-spawn Xbox smoke (or a Mid CT smoke) before crossing, and jump-peek with a T AWP only from cover.

powerPositions.why: Off-angle onto the Long Doors exit at mid range; Ts running out of the doors must check several angles at once.
powerPositions.counter: Flash over the doors, then swing Pit wide with two players; a molotov into Pit forces the CT to reveal or leave.

powerPositions.why: Covered spot at the top of Long that holds the lane and falls back to site easily.
powerPositions.counter: Smoke Long Corner/A cross from Blue (Valve 'A Cross' lineup) and walk up the far side; flash high over the car.

powerPositions.why: Hidden corner at the back of A that sees Ramp and the plant area; often missed when clearing site.
powerPositions.counter: Molotov or HE into Goose before you plant; clear it with a teammate watching Short.

powerPositions.why: For Ts, holding Short splits A and gives a high angle over site and CT Spawn; for CTs, an early Short peek kills Catwalk walkers.
powerPositions.counter: CT: molotov Short Stairs and hold the exit from site/CT Spawn. T: smoke CT Spawn first and flash over the Short wall.

powerPositions.why: Raised B position that sees the tunnel exit and B Doors and is hard to flash.
powerPositions.counter: Molotov the platform on the execute, pop-flash out of Upper Tunnels and trade in pairs.

powerPositions.why: Ts control access to B from here; a CT who pushes it early gets free information and can delay a rush.
powerPositions.counter: CT: push only with a flash and a teammate ready at B. T: keep a player back in Outside Tunnels to punish the push.

powerPositions.why: T AWP or rifle here can hold Mid Doors and Mid crosses, denying CT information plays.
powerPositions.counter: CT: smoke Top of Mid or cross only behind utility; switch to Lower Tunnels for information.

Ts walking up Suicide are in line with the door gap.
T AWP angle into the door gap and CT crosses at the bottom of Mid.

Holds the whole of Long from the top; Ts crossing without smoke are exposed.

maps.spawns: T Spawn bottom centre; CT Spawn top centre-right next to A. Estimated minimum run times (shortest line across the CS2 nav mesh from the spawn-zone centre to the edge of the plant zone; knife 250 u/s to AK 215 u/s; real runs are a little slower, and a nav-area-centre route gave values up to about 30% higher): CT to A about 3-3.5 s, CT to B about 8-9 s; T to A via Long about 18-21 s, T to B via Tunnels about 17.5-20.5 s; A to B site-to-site about 10.5-12.5 s.

modeTips.t: Default: take Mid control early with the T-spawn Xbox smoke (Valve lineup) so players can cross to Catwalk or Lower; one or two on Long for door control, one in Upper Tunnels for B information, then react. A Long execute: smoke the A cross from Blue (Valve 'A Cross' lineup), smoke CT Spawn from Catwalk (Valve 'CT' lineup) if Short is joining, flash over Long Doors, molotov Pit or A Car, then take Long with Short players pinching. B execute: smoke B Doors from Outside Tunnels (Valve lineup), smoke the platform/window side if you have it, pop-flash out of the tunnel exit, molotov Back Plat or B Car, plant default and post-plant from Tunnels.
modeTips.ct: Standard 2-1-2: two A (one on Long at Pit/A Car/Long Corner, one on site or Short, often with the AWP at CT Spawn or Long), one Mid (Mid Doors AWP or CT Mid rifle who rotates and checks Lower), two B (one site/Back Plat anchor, one B Doors or window). Common variations: Mid player pushes Lower for information, aggressive Long peek with a flash at the round start, B anchor plays alone while the Mid player covers Doors. Spend molotovs on Short Stairs and Upper Tunnels to buy rotation time; Valve's CT smokes 'Long A Doors' (thrown from near A) and 'B Tunnel' (thrown from B) block Long Doors and the tunnel exit against rushes.
modeTips.pistol: T: fast B through Upper Tunnels with flashes and the B Doors smoke, or a Long hit with the cross smoke; drop extra pistols or armour for the second round. CT: stack two on B or on Long and save utility for the retake; avoid lone Mid peeks with a pistol against a T rush.
modeTips.retake: A: group at CT Spawn and Short, smoke the Long cross or Ramp, flash over the platform, clear Goose and A Car, then defuse with cover on Long. B: come together through B Doors behind a flash and send one player through Mid Doors and Lower Tunnels to hit the tunnel exit from behind; molotov the car and default plant.
modeTips.postplant: After an A plant: one player on Long (Blue or Long Doors), one on Short or Catwalk, one hidden on site (Goose or A Car); keep a molotov for the default plant. After a B plant: play the tunnel exit from Upper Tunnels, one Back Plat or B Car, one lurk near CT Mid/B Doors to catch the rotation; molotov the default plant from Tunnels.

maps.weaponFit: AWP: Mid Doors down Mid, Pit or Long Corner on Long, CT Spawn onto Short; T side at Top of Mid or Long Doors. Rifles: Long A duels, Catwalk/Short trades and Back Plat on B. SMGs and shotguns: Upper Tunnels rushes, close angles at Goose, B Car and Back Plat, eco stacks on B. Pistol and eco rounds favour tunnels and doors where ranges are short.
mistakes: Walking up Suicide or Top of Mid without a smoke against the Mid Doors AWP
Running through Long Doors with no cross smoke or flash
Staying in Pit after the first trade so the CT gets trapped
CT Mid player over-rotating and leaving Mid Doors open for a split
Not clearing Goose and A Car before planting or defusing on A
Peeking the B tunnel exit alone with no flash or teammate
T side forcing Long only and ignoring Mid, giving CTs free rotations
Retaking B only through Doors instead of also coming from Lower/Upper Tunnels

searchAndDestroy.A notes: Raised platform top-right with stacked crates. Ts arrive from Long (A Ramp, after Long Doors and Pit) and from Short (Catwalk). CTs hold from Pit/A Car on Long, Goose and the platform on site, and CT Spawn for Short. Plants named in Valve's retake file: default, 'safe plant spot, for Long', 'mid-site', 'for catwalk' and 'on box for Long'. Retakes come from CT Spawn and Short (B players rotate through CT Mid); smoke the Long cross or Ramp to cut the Long post-plant, flash over the platform, clear Goose and A Car.
searchAndDestroy.B notes: Walled courtyard top-left with a back platform, crates and a wrecked car. Ts enter from Upper Tunnels; CTs enter through B Doors from CT Mid. Plants named in Valve's retake file: default, 'under window', 'mid-site box' and 'for tunnels'. Retakes: smoke or flash through B Doors while one player comes behind the Ts through Mid Doors, Lower Tunnels and Upper Tunnels; Back Plat and B Car must be cleared.

utilityPlans.name: Long A take
utilityPlans.how: Throw the Long Corner smoke from spawn. As the first players walk through Long Doors, flash Long and Pit. Burn A Car, then smoke A Cross from Blue and cross onto the site together.

utilityPlans.name: A split, Short and Long
utilityPlans.how: Two players take Short behind Xbox and the CT cross smoke while three hold Long. Burn Goose and pop the Short entry flash, while Long flashes and smokes A Cross. Everyone goes on the flashes.

utilityPlans.name: B execute from Tunnels
utilityPlans.how: One player smokes B Doors and Window from Outside Tunnels. As the smokes bloom, throw the HE and molotov onto Back Plat, then pop the entry flash and run out together.

utilityPlans.name: Fast B rush
utilityPlans.how: Throw the fast B Doors smoke on the run from spawn, then stack Upper Tunnels. Burn Back Plat, pop the entry flash and run out as five before CTs rotate.

utilityPlans.name: Mid control into B split
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Xbox and Mid Doors from spawn, then take Top of Mid and Catwalk. Flash Mid Doors before peeking, then cross to Lower Tunnels to join a B hit or split A.

utilityPlans.name: Retake A
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Long Doors to cut off rotating Ts. Flash A site from CT Spawn and burn the plant area, then walk in from CT and Short at the same time.

utilityPlans.name: Retake B
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Upper Tunnels to stop late T rotations. Flash over B Doors from CT Mid, burn Back Plat and under Window, then enter through Doors as a group.

maps.name: Inferno
maps.setting: Small Italian village: plaster houses, terracotta roofs, cobbled streets, flower boxes, balconies, a church square at B and an apartment block between T side and A. CS2 version updated at CS2 launch; Active Duty throughout CS2.
maps.layout: On the official radar T Spawn is far left (west) and CT Spawn on the right (east). B site sits at the top, reached by the long, curving Banana from the T side and by the CT lane along the top from CT Spawn. A site is bottom-right, reached by Mid (Top Mid, then Short or Long A), by Apartments ending at Balcony, and by CTs through Library, Moto and Arch. Second Mid is a lower street under the apartments.

callouts.name: T Spawn
callouts.look: Small cobbled square on the far left (west) edge of the radar with plaster houses, terracotta roofs and narrow exits.
callouts.use: Ts start here. Exits east toward Bottom Banana and Top Mid, and into T Apps for the Apartments route.

callouts.name: T Apps
callouts.look: Stairway and doorway from the T side up into the apartment block.
callouts.use: Start of the Apartments route to A. CTs who push Apartments early can catch Ts climbing here.

callouts.name: Apartments
callouts.look: Upstairs rooms and corridors with wooden floors, beds and kitchen furniture, windows looking down on the streets.
callouts.use: T route to A via Boiler and Balcony; aggressive CTs push it with utility for early information.

callouts.name: Boiler
callouts.look: Small room in the apartments with a boiler/heater, just before Balcony.
callouts.use: Ts stack here before dropping Balcony; CTs throw molotovs and HEs into it to stop the Apartments push.

callouts.name: Balcony
callouts.look: First-floor balcony with a railing at the end of Apartments, overlooking the south side of A.
callouts.use: T entry to A from Apartments. CTs on site hold it; Ts flash from Boiler before dropping down.

callouts.name: Second Mid
callouts.look: Narrow lower street south of Mid, running under the apartment block.
callouts.use: Alternative T path into Mid and toward Long that avoids Top Mid. Official place name 'Second Mid'.

callouts.name: Top Mid
callouts.look: Junction east of T Spawn where the path from Bottom Banana and the T side open into Mid, with house corners and windows.
callouts.use: T entry to Mid and the link to Bottom Banana. CTs peek it early from Short/Arch side; Valve's 'Left Top Mid' smoke from here blocks that angle.

callouts.name: Mid
callouts.look: Wide cobbled street between Top Mid and the A approaches, lined with doorways and corners.
callouts.use: Controls access to Short and Long; Ts win it to split A. Valve's CT 'Mid' smoke from near Arch lands on Top Mid.

callouts.name: Short
callouts.look: Lane leading north and east from Mid toward the north side of A and the Arch.
callouts.use: Mid route onto A that meets the Arch side. CTs at Arch and Library cover it; Ts smoke Arch/Library before pushing.

callouts.name: Long A
callouts.look: Street running east from Mid along the south side of the map into the south-west corner of A.
callouts.use: Main T route from Mid to A; watched from Pit and the site boxes. Ts molotov Pit before walking out.

callouts.name: A Site
callouts.look: Small stone square in the bottom-right with a central box stack, walls and doorways; Balcony above one side and the sunken Pit at the corner.
callouts.use: Bomb site A. Ts arrive from Long, Short and Balcony; CTs from Library, Moto and Arch.

callouts.name: Pit
callouts.look: Sunken stone hollow at the south-east corner of A, below site level, reached by steps.
callouts.use: Classic CT AWP/rifle spot watching Long and the site; Ts molotov it on executes. Hard to leave once Ts are on site.

callouts.name: Graveyard
callouts.look: Small fenced plot with gravestones beside A, near Pit.
callouts.use: Close CT hiding spot and a T post-plant spot; Ts molotov it on executes. Official Inferno place name.

callouts.name: Moto
callouts.look: Gap at the north-east side of A between the site and Library, on the CT approach.
callouts.use: CT rotation path into A; Valve's 'A Site Moto' smoke from Top Mid lands here to cut that support.

callouts.name: Library
callouts.look: Building on the CT side east of A with shelves and a doorway onto the site.
callouts.use: CT entrance to A and a hold position; Ts smoke it on A executes. Official place name 'Library'.

callouts.name: Arch
callouts.look: Stone archway on the CT side between CT Spawn and the A/Mid area.
callouts.use: CT route to Short and A; an AWP here can watch Short toward Mid. Ts smoke it on A hits.

callouts.name: CT Spawn
callouts.look: Small square on the right (east) edge between the A and B approaches, with stone buildings around it.
callouts.use: CTs start here. Paths: south via Library/Arch to A, north-west along the CT lane to B. Valve's CT smokes for Banana and Mid are thrown nearby.

callouts.name: CT
callouts.look: Street along the top of the map from CT Spawn west to the east side of B.
callouts.use: CT rotation route to B and the retake entry; Ts smoke it on B executes (Valve 'CT Boost' smoke from Banana lands at its B end).

callouts.name: Construction
callouts.look: Scaffolding and building works at the back-right (north-east) of B, near the CT entrance.
callouts.use: CT hold spot on B and a post-plant hide; check it when entering site.

callouts.name: Coffins
callouts.look: Stone coffins at the back of B near the CT entrance, in front of the church.
callouts.use: CT hide spot watching Top Banana and site; T post-plant cover. Valve's 'Coffins' smoke from Banana blocks it.

callouts.name: Fountain
callouts.look: Stone fountain in the middle of B site.
callouts.use: Central cover on B; a common plant reference ('behind fountain' in Valve's retake file).

callouts.name: B Site
callouts.look: Open square in front of a church at the top of the radar, with the fountain, sandbags at the front, coffins at the back and a dark corner.
callouts.use: Bomb site B. Ts enter from Banana; CTs from the CT lane and Construction. The church is in the loading-screen area names.

callouts.name: Sandbags
callouts.look: Sandbag wall at the front of B facing the top of Banana.
callouts.use: CT cover to hold Banana and T cover for post-plant; a common molotov target.

callouts.name: Top Banana
callouts.look: Top end of the Banana lane where it opens onto B, near a parked car.
callouts.use: Last choke before B; whoever holds it controls B. Ts smoke CT/Coffins from Banana before stepping out.

callouts.name: Car
callouts.look: Small car parked at the top of Banana.
callouts.use: CT spot to hold Banana from cover and T post-plant cover. Molotov or HE it before walking up.

callouts.name: Logs
callouts.look: Pile of wooden logs on the upper half of Banana.
callouts.use: Cover on Banana for both sides during the early fight; official Inferno place name.

callouts.name: Banana
callouts.look: Long, narrow, curving stone lane between high walls with a low half-wall and plant beds.
callouts.use: The key lane to B. CTs delay with molotov and HE; Ts smoke the half-wall/CT side to move up. Valve ships a CT 'Banana Half-Wall' smoke.

callouts.name: Bottom Banana
callouts.look: Bottom of the Banana lane on the T side, by stone steps and a corner joining Top Mid.
callouts.use: T entry to Banana. CTs who win early Banana control peek here with a flash; Ts hold it with an AWP.

powerPositions.why: Covered CT spot at the top of Banana that sees the lane; with a molotov thrown first it can stop a full rush.
powerPositions.counter: HE or molotov the car, smoke the CT side and Coffins from Banana, then swing in pairs.

powerPositions.why: Deep CT angle on B that sees Top Banana and the plant area while staying near the CT exit.
powerPositions.counter: Valve 'Coffins' smoke from Banana, flash over the church side, clear it before planting.

powerPositions.why: Front-of-site cover that holds Banana and is a strong T post-plant spot.
powerPositions.counter: Molotov behind the bags, or flash and wide-swing from Top Banana with a trade.

powerPositions.why: Sunken AWP/rifle spot covering Long and site; Ts running out of Long are in the open.
powerPositions.counter: Molotov Pit before taking Long, smoke it for the plant, or come from Balcony to flank it.

powerPositions.why: CT door onto A that holds the site and links to CT Spawn for fast support.
powerPositions.counter: Smoke Library and Moto (Valve 'A Site Moto' lineup from Top Mid) before the execute.

powerPositions.why: AWP angle down Short toward Mid; delays Mid splits and links A and CT Spawn.
powerPositions.counter: Valve 'Left Top Mid' smoke from Top Mid, then cross Mid together.

powerPositions.why: Early CT push here wins information and catches Ts climbing T Apps; for Ts, holding it threatens A at any time.
powerPositions.counter: Molotov/HE the stairs and Boiler, and keep a teammate watching the apartments path.

powerPositions.why: High T entry over A that forces CTs on site to look up as well as at Long and Short.
powerPositions.counter: CT: molotov Boiler/Balcony as Ts arrive and hold it from a site angle that also covers Long.

maps.spawns: T Spawn far left (west); CT Spawn on the right (east). Estimated minimum run times (shortest line across the CS2 nav mesh from the spawn-zone centre to the edge of the plant zone; knife 250 u/s to AK 215 u/s; real runs are a little slower, and a nav-area-centre route gave values up to about 30% higher): CT to A about 6.5-7.5 s, CT to B about 8.5-10 s; T to A via Mid about 17-20 s, T to B via Banana about 16.5-19 s; A to B site-to-site about 14-16 s, so call rotations early.

modeTips.t: Default: contest Banana early (HE or molotov the car, smoke the CT side) while one or two take Apartments and Top Mid quietly; react to what Banana tells you. B execute from Banana: Valve 'Coffins' and 'CT Boost' smokes, molotov Sandbags/Car or the dark corner, flash over Top Banana, enter in pairs, plant default or behind the fountain. A execute: Valve 'A Site Moto' smoke from Top Mid, 'Left Top Mid' smoke for the Arch side, smoke Library, molotov Pit and Graveyard, flash from Boiler, then hit Balcony, Long and Short together.
modeTips.ct: Common setup: two B (one Banana player with molotov and HE at round start holding from Car/Sandbags, one site anchor at Coffins/Construction), one Arch/Library rotator or AWP watching Short, two A (one Pit or site, one Apartments/Balcony). Banana control is the main CT investment; never leave the Banana player without a trade. Valve's CT smokes from near CT Spawn ('Banana', 'Banana Half-Wall', 'Mid') slow pushes when you lose the early fight.
modeTips.pistol: T: Banana rush with flashes or a fast Apartments hit on A; plant quickly and hold from cover. CT: two on Banana with flashes and an HE, the rest ready to rotate; avoid lone Apartments pushes with a pistol.
modeTips.retake: B: group on the CT lane, smoke the Banana exit, flash over Coffins and the fountain, clear Construction and the dark corner. A: come from Library and Arch together, smoke Long and Short, flash over, clear Pit and Graveyard; use the Balcony drop only if Apartments is clear.
modeTips.postplant: B plant: hold from Banana (Car, Logs, Top Banana) and one deep corner, keep a molotov for the default plant. A plant: hold from Long, Balcony/Apartments and Short or Mid; avoid sitting in Pit if CTs can flash it from Library.

maps.weaponFit: AWP: Arch/Short for Mid, Pit for Long, Car or Coffins on B for Banana; T AWP at Bottom Banana or Top Mid. Rifles: Banana trades, A site holds and Mid fights. SMGs and shotguns: Apartments, Boiler, Balcony, Coffins and B corners; strong on CT force buys. Molotov and HE are worth more than usual on Banana and in Apartments.
mistakes: Giving up Banana control at the round start for free
Walking up Banana into a molotov without smoking the CT side
Dropping Balcony without flashing from Boiler
Forgetting to clear Pit and Graveyard on A
CT Banana player taking a fight with no trade
Ts committing all five to Apartments while CTs flank through Mid
Planting B in the open with nobody holding Banana for the post-plant
Late CT rotation from A to B (about 14-16 s site-to-site)

searchAndDestroy.A notes: Small square bottom-right with a central box stack, Pit at the south-east corner and Graveyard beside it, Balcony above. Ts hit from Long, Short and Balcony; CTs hold Pit, the site boxes, Library and Arch. Plants named in Valve's retake file: default, 'safe, for Pit', 'corner site', 'mid site' and 'safe big box'. Retakes come from Library, Moto and Arch: smoke Long and Short exits, flash over, clear Pit and Graveyard before the defuse.
searchAndDestroy.B notes: Church square at the top with the fountain in the middle, Sandbags at the front, Coffins and Construction at the back and a dark corner. Ts enter only from Banana; CTs from the CT lane/Construction. Plants in Valve's retake file: default, 'behind fountain', 'towards emo' (the dark back corner) and 'for banana'. Retakes: smoke the Banana exit, come through CT and Construction with flashes, clear Coffins and the corners, and send one player round to Banana if time allows.

utilityPlans.name: B execute from Banana
utilityPlans.how: Take Banana first. Smoke CT and Coffins, molotov the Oranges and Quad from Car, then flash the B entrance from Logs. Enter past Sandbags and use the CT flash to clear the CT side.

utilityPlans.name: A execute through Short and Long
utilityPlans.how: Throw Moto, Arch and Library smokes from Second Mid. A mid player smokes Pit from the Short and Long corner, then flashes Short. Hit Short and Long together so site CTs face two sides.

utilityPlans.name: A execute through Apartments
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Moto with Valve's lineup from Mid. Apartments players burn Pit and flash the site from the Balcony exit, while a mid player flashes Short. Drop from Balcony and push Short at the same time.

utilityPlans.name: Retake A
utilityPlans.how: Retake from Arch, Library and Long. Burn Pit from the Arch trash can, then molotov the back of site and the default plant from the Long mailbox. Swing together once the fires land.

utilityPlans.name: Retake B
utilityPlans.how: Smoke the B entrance from Moto so Ts on Banana cannot help. Burn Dark and Car from CT, then flash Top Banana. Enter from CT and Construction together and trade each other.

maps.name: Mirage
maps.setting: Sandy Moroccan-style town: sand-coloured stone, blue and teal tiles, palm trees, a palace and a market. Bomb defusal map, Active Duty in CS2 (Premier and Competitive).
maps.layout: Three lanes. T Spawn east (radar right), CT Spawn south-west. A site south, fed by T Ramp and Palace from the east, Connector/Jungle/Stairs from the north and CT/Ticket Booth from the west. B site north-west, fed by Apartments (long upper corridor along the top) and Short (catwalk off mid), with Market and Kitchen as CT entries. Mid runs east-west through the centre: Top Mid, Window, Connector, Underpass, Ladder Room, Short.

callouts.name: T Spawn
callouts.look: Sandy courtyard at the far east (right of the radar). Low walls, crates and the start of three exits: Palace Alley south, the alley to Top Mid west, and the stairs up to T Apartments north.
callouts.use: Terrorist start. Valve's official Window and Connector smoke lineups are thrown from here, so it is where most mid defaults begin.

callouts.name: T Ramp
callouts.look: Sloped stone street running south-west from T spawn down towards A. Tetris boxes and the site open up at the bottom; Palace Alley sits beside the top of it.
callouts.use: Main T entry to A. CTs on site (Stairs, Firebox, Default) all watch its exit, so Ts smoke or flash before walking out. Valve's T Ramp smoke is thrown from A by CTs.

callouts.name: Palace
callouts.look: Indoor palace south-east of A: arched stone rooms, tiled floor, then a raised balcony with short steps that drop onto A site.
callouts.use: Second T entry to A. Splits A with Ramp. CTs molly or spam the balcony exit; Ts flash over the arch before dropping. Lurkers use it late to cut CT rotations.

callouts.name: A Site
callouts.look: Open sandy plaza with wooden crates in the middle, stone stairs up to Jungle on the north-west and the palace balcony on the south-east.
callouts.use: Bomb site A. Wide open, so Ts need smokes on CT, Jungle and Stairs to plant safely; CTs fight from cover around the edges and retake from three sides.

callouts.name: A Default
callouts.look: The main wooden crate stack near the middle-east of A, the usual plant spot in Valve's retake file.
callouts.use: Default plant spot. Plant here and post-plant from Palace, Ramp or Tetris. CTs defusing here are exposed to Palace and Ramp.

callouts.name: Triple
callouts.look: Three-box crate stack on the west side of the site, closer to CT and Ticket Booth.
callouts.use: Plant spot listed by Valve ('triple'). Cover for a CT on site and a safer plant against Jungle. Ts molly it on executes.

callouts.name: Firebox
callouts.look: Wooden crate tucked under the palace wall at the south-east corner of the site, right next to the palace steps.
callouts.use: Close-range CT spot that covers Palace and the Ramp exit. Ts molly or flash it before entering; post-plant it is a hiding spot for a lurker.

callouts.name: Tetris
callouts.look: Small cluster of boxes at the bottom of T Ramp where it meets the site, shaped like a stepped block.
callouts.use: First cover for Ts coming down Ramp. CTs pre-aim it; Ts use it as the post-plant position for the default plant.

callouts.name: Sandwich
callouts.look: Narrow gap between wall pieces near the Ramp exit and Tetris, where a player can tuck in out of sight of Ramp.
callouts.use: Off-angle for a CT or lurker. Ts check it with a molly or a flash when entering from Ramp.

callouts.name: Ninja
callouts.look: Dark corner at the south-east of the site beside the palace balcony, behind Firebox.
callouts.use: Hiding corner used for late defuses and post-plant surprises. Check it when you clear Palace and Firebox.

callouts.name: Stairs
callouts.look: Stone steps at the north-west corner of A leading up to Jungle, with a low wall at the top.
callouts.use: CT link between Jungle/Connector and A. A CT on Stairs sees Ramp exit and the site; Valve's CT smoke for A executes covers this side.

callouts.name: Jungle
callouts.look: Small room north-west of A with a wooden half-wall and plants, joining Connector to Stairs and Window.
callouts.use: Key CT anchor for A and mid. Ts smoke it on A executes; CTs play it with an AWP or a rifle to watch Connector and Ramp.

callouts.name: CT
callouts.look: Wide entrance at the west of A from CT spawn, with the Ticket Booth kiosk just to its south.
callouts.use: CT rotation path into A. Valve's official CT smoke (from T side) lands here to cut it off on executes.

callouts.name: Ticket Booth
callouts.look: Small kiosk with a window at the south-west of A, between CT entrance and the site.
callouts.use: CT hiding spot and retake entry. Close-range angle on Default and the Palace exit. Ts smoke CT and booth together.

callouts.name: CT Spawn
callouts.look: Paved yard at the south-west (green zone on the radar) with steps up towards Window and doors east to A.
callouts.use: CT start. Links to A via CT entrance, to Window, and to B via Market. Late-round Ts lurk near here to cut rotations.

callouts.name: Connector
callouts.look: Narrow corridor south of mid with stone steps, running from Mid down to Jungle.
callouts.use: Mid-to-A link. Ts take it to split A; CTs hold it from Jungle. Valve's Connector smoke from T spawn blocks the CT view of it.

callouts.name: Window
callouts.look: Raised room with a wooden window frame looking east down the whole of mid towards Top Mid.
callouts.use: Main CT AWP spot. Sees Top Mid, Mid and the Connector entrance. Valve's official Window smoke from T spawn blinds it.

callouts.name: Mid
callouts.look: Long open street in the centre with crates, Window to the west, Connector to the south and Underpass steps to the north.
callouts.use: Central lane. Whoever controls it can split A (Connector) or B (Short/Underpass). Crossing it without smoke on Window is a common way to die.

callouts.name: Top Mid
callouts.look: Wider open space at the east end of mid, near the alley from T spawn, with boxes and a view straight at Window.
callouts.use: T control point for the mid default. Ts often place an AWP here early; CTs peek it from Window or Short.

callouts.name: Ladder Room
callouts.look: Small room above Underpass with a ladder in the floor, opening onto Short.
callouts.use: Connects Underpass to Short. Ts use it to reach B Short quietly; CTs on Short watch the ladder top.

callouts.name: Short
callouts.look: Raised catwalk running north-west from the side of mid to B site, with a low wall and the arches to B at its end.
callouts.use: Mid route to B. CTs hold it to stop B splits; Valve's 'Cat' smoke from T Apartments lands here.

callouts.name: Underpass
callouts.look: Dark tunnel under the north side of mid with stairs down from Mid and a stairway up into the Apartments corridor.
callouts.use: T route from mid to B Apartments. Lurkers sit here; CTs molly the stairs or watch from Short.

callouts.name: T Apartments
callouts.look: Indoor rooms north of T spawn (radar top-right) with carpets and stairs, leading west along the top of the map.
callouts.use: Start of the Apartments route to B. Valve's 'Cat' smoke for B Short is thrown from here.

callouts.name: Apartments
callouts.look: Long upper-floor corridor with rooms and a balcony at its west end that drops onto B site.
callouts.use: Main T route to B. CTs molly or hold the exit; Valve's 'Apts' smoke from B site blocks it on defence.

callouts.name: B Site
callouts.look: Small walled courtyard in the north-west with a parked van, a bench and the apartment balcony above.
callouts.use: Bomb site B. Enclosed, so short-range fights and fast rushes decide it. CTs retake from Market, Kitchen and Short.

callouts.name: Van
callouts.look: White van parked at the north-west of B under the apartments balcony.
callouts.use: CT anchor cover that watches the Apartments exit and Short. Ts molly behind it on executes.

callouts.name: Bench
callouts.look: Stone bench along the site wall in B, near the Market side.
callouts.use: CT hiding spot and post-plant cover. Ts check or molly it after entering from Apartments.

callouts.name: Market
callouts.look: Indoor shop south of B with a door and a window onto the site, linking to CT spawn.
callouts.use: CT rotation path to B and a retake entry. Ts smoke Market Window and molly or flash Market Door on B executes.

callouts.name: Kitchen
callouts.look: Small tiled room between B site and CT side, west of Market.
callouts.use: Second CT entry to B. A retake from Kitchen and Market at once is hard for Ts to hold.

maps.spawns: T Spawn: east edge, centre row (overview icon at 0.87, 0.36). CT Spawn: south-west (icon 0.28, 0.70), next to A and a short walk to Market for B. A is the closer site for CTs; B is reached through Market or across via Jungle and Short. Rotation times were not confirmed from a source this session, so none are given.

modeTips.t: Default: smoke Window from T spawn (Valve lineup), take Top Mid and Underpass, keep one player each on Palace and Ramp for info. A execute: smoke CT, Jungle and Stairs (Ticket Booth too if you have it), molly Firebox or Triple, flash over Palace, then go Palace, Ramp and Connector together. B execute: smoke Market Window and Market Door or Kitchen, molly Van or Bench, flash over the balcony, then go Apartments and Short at the same time.
modeTips.ct: Common setup: one A (Firebox, Ticket Booth or Stairs), one Jungle/Connector, one Window or Short for mid, one Market or Van for B, one floating. AWP in Window or Jungle. Early round: molly Apartments stairs or Palace to slow rushes; smoke Top Mid to stop T AWP picks. Fall back rather than re-peek after giving info.
modeTips.pistol: Ts often rush B Apartments or A Ramp with five; a molly or two well-timed flashes on the exits wins it for CTs. CTs: stack two on B and one Jungle, play close angles where pistols win. Kevlar plus a utility grenade is the common buy.
modeTips.retake: A: retake from CT/Booth and Stairs/Jungle at once, with Connector if mid is free; smoke Palace and Ramp to isolate the site. B: Market and Kitchen together, flash over the window, then check Van, Bench and the balcony. Trade in pairs.
modeTips.postplant: A default plant: hold from Palace, Ramp/Tetris and Connector. B plant: hold from Apartments balcony, Short and a lurker near Market. Save a molly for the defuse. C4 blast damage was reworked in July 2026 (Season 5): re-check safe distances in practice.

maps.weaponFit: AWP: Window, Jungle and Top Mid are the main lines. Rifles everywhere. SMGs and shotguns fit B site, Apartments, Palace and Market (short range). Mid AWP fights decide many rounds.
mistakes: Crossing mid without a smoke on Window
Walking out of Ramp without clearing Tetris, Sandwich and Firebox
Dropping from Palace with no flash
Rushing B Apartments into a molly with no counter-utility
CTs re-peeking Top Mid after giving the first info
Retaking B one by one through Market only
Forgetting the Connector split on A executes
Letting a lurker in Underpass cut the B to A rotation

searchAndDestroy.A notes: Open plaza. Ts enter from T Ramp (via Tetris), Palace (balcony steps) and Connector/Jungle/Stairs; CTs from CT and Ticket Booth. Valve's retake file names four plants: default, Triple, mid-site for Ramp, and a Connector-side plant. Standard retake: CT and Booth together, plus Jungle/Stairs, with a third player through Connector if mid is free.
searchAndDestroy.B notes: Small enclosed site. Ts enter from Apartments (balcony) and Short (arches); CTs from Market (door and window) and Kitchen. Valve's retake plants: default, a plant for Cat (Short), mid-site, and a back pillar plant. Retake from Market and Kitchen at once while a third player checks Short.

objectives.other: Mirage is in Premier (Active Duty), Competitive, Casual, Retakes and Deathmatch map lists in the Oct 22 2026 build.

utilityPlans.name: A execute from T Spawn path
utilityPlans.how: Three players throw the CT, Jungle and Stairs smokes from the T Spawn path so they land together. Molotov Sandwich, then flash from the ramp door. Enter from T Ramp while a Palace player swings at the same time.

utilityPlans.name: Mid to A split
utilityPlans.how: Two players take mid behind the Window and top Connector smokes. The rest smoke Ticket Booth and Stairs and flash from the ramp door. Mid players push Connector as the ramp group enters, so site CTs face two angles.

utilityPlans.name: B execute through Apartments
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Market window and the Kitchen door from Back Alley, and Short with Valve's Cat smoke. Molotov Bench, then flash out of Apartments. Clear Van and Arch as a group and plant for the retake.

utilityPlans.name: Mid control
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Window from T Spawn and top Connector from the cart. A player on the Apartments ramp flashes bottom mid, and mid players take Underpass and Ladder Room. Swap the Window smoke for the Window molotov when you want the sniper out.

utilityPlans.name: Retake A
utilityPlans.how: Cut T Ramp with the CT Spawn smoke so no T can join late. Use the HE grenades on the plant spots and Tetris, then burn Firebox. Enter from CT, Jungle and Stairs at the same time.

utilityPlans.name: Retake B
utilityPlans.how: Smoke Apartments with Valve's Apts lineup so no T can join from there. Retake from Short, Market and Arch together and trade each other. If a CT is still on site, burn the Apartments exit instead.

maps.name: Nuke
maps.setting: Nuclear power plant: warehouse-style buildings with yellow rails, a big open outside yard with silos and containers, and a lower concrete level. Bomb defusal map, Active Duty in CS2 (Premier and Competitive).
maps.layout: Two levels stacked. A site is inside the main building on the upper level; B site is directly below it on the lower level. T Spawn west, CT Spawn east. Ts reach A through Lobby (Hut, Squeaky) or from Outside (Mini); B through Ramp (top of the radar, sloping down) or Secret (from the south-east of Outside). Vents drop from A into B. Elevation tags: 'underground' marks the lower level shown by the lower radar image; 'ground' the main level.

callouts.name: T Spawn
callouts.look: Fenced yard at the far west (radar left) with trucks and a long path east towards the plant buildings.
callouts.use: Terrorist start. Exits to Outside (south-east), Lobby (east) and up to T Roof. Valve's outside smoke lineups start a short walk east of here.

callouts.name: T Roof
callouts.look: Flat roof above Lobby reached from the T side, with low parapets looking south over Outside and the silos.
callouts.use: T vantage over Outside. Useful for early AWP looks at Garage and for dropping into the yard; exposed to CT snipers if overused.

callouts.name: Lobby
callouts.look: Indoor entrance hall of the plant, west of A, with light walls, round tables and doors north (Trophy/Vending) and east (Hut, Squeaky).
callouts.use: T staging area for A and Ramp. CTs flash or molly it early to stop fast pushes.

callouts.name: Trophy
callouts.look: Small room north of Lobby with a trophy cabinet, leading towards Radio and the top of Ramp.
callouts.use: T path from Lobby to Ramp. CTs pushing up Ramp check it.

callouts.name: Vending
callouts.look: Corner of Lobby with vending machines, between the T entrance and Trophy.
callouts.use: Common T hold spot inside Lobby; also where CT flashes from Ramp land.

callouts.name: Radio
callouts.look: Room at the north-west corner of A's building between Trophy and the top of Ramp.
callouts.use: T connector into Ramp. Holding it gives Ts Ramp control; CTs throw utility into it from Ramp. Valve's CS:GO nav labels this room 'Control'.

callouts.name: Ramp
callouts.look: Teal-coloured sloped hallway at the top of the radar that turns and runs down into B site.
callouts.use: Main T route to B and the main mid-round contest. A CT holding Ramp can push for info or fall back to B; the radar switches to the lower image as you go down it.

callouts.name: Squeaky
callouts.look: Metal door from the south end of Lobby into A site; it makes a loud squeak when opened.
callouts.use: T entry to A. CTs in Heaven and on site pre-aim the door; open it with a flash or wait for teammates.

callouts.name: Hut
callouts.look: Small wooden room on the west wall of A with windows, opening from the Lobby side onto the site.
callouts.use: T entry to A next to Squeaky. CTs in Heaven look straight at its exit; smoke Heaven before stepping out.

callouts.name: Hut Roof
callouts.look: Top of the hut structure inside A, a raised ledge above the site floor.
callouts.use: Off-angle for Ts and CTs that sees most of the site and Heaven. Clear it when entering from Hut or Squeaky.

callouts.name: A Site
callouts.look: Large warehouse room on the upper level with yellow rails, big tanks and crates in the centre, Heaven's platform on the east wall.
callouts.use: Bomb site A (upper level). It sits right above B, so sounds and Vents link the two sites.

callouts.name: Heaven
callouts.look: Raised CT platform with yellow railings on the east side of A, overlooking Hut, Squeaky and the site floor.
callouts.use: Strongest CT spot on A: height over every T entry. Ts smoke or flash it on every A execute.

callouts.name: Hell
callouts.look: Floor area under Heaven on the east side of A, by the CT doors.
callouts.use: CT entry to A from Lockers and a close-range hiding spot under Heaven.

callouts.name: Rafters
callouts.look: Narrow walkways high above A under the roof, reached from Heaven.
callouts.use: Rare CT/T off-angle over the site; mainly for surprise and post-plant holds.

callouts.name: Mini
callouts.look: Small structure on the south side of A's building facing Outside, next to the site's south doors.
callouts.use: Link between Outside and A. CTs hold it to watch Outside; Valve's 'Close Mini' smoke from T Outside blocks it.

callouts.name: Lockers
callouts.look: CT room with lockers between Hell, the CT yard and the Back Stairs down to B.
callouts.use: CT rotation hub: A via Hell, B via Back Stairs, Outside via the yard.

callouts.name: Admin
callouts.look: Room at the north-east corner of A's building between Hell and the top of Ramp.
callouts.use: CT path to Ramp from the A side, used to contest Ramp or rotate. Name taken from Valve's CS:GO nav place list.

callouts.name: Vents
callouts.look: Metal ventilation shaft that opens on A's floor and drops down into B site.
callouts.use: One-way fast rotation from A to B (drop only). CTs use it to reach B; Ts use it after taking A to split B.

callouts.name: Outside
callouts.look: Big open yard south of the buildings with silos, containers and long sight lines from T side to Garage and the CT yard.
callouts.use: Third lane. Ts take it with a smoke wall to reach Secret (B) or Mini (A); CT snipers hold it from the CT side.

callouts.name: Silo
callouts.look: Large round white silo on Outside, south of Lobby, that players can climb.
callouts.use: T cover and height on Outside; a climbed Silo sees across the yard towards Garage.

callouts.name: Red
callouts.look: Long red shipping container lying in the middle of Outside.
callouts.use: Cover for Ts crossing Outside and for CTs pushing the yard.

callouts.name: Garage
callouts.look: Tan building at the south-east of Outside with red crates inside, near the Secret stairs.
callouts.use: CT position covering Outside and Secret. Valve's 'Garage' and 'Far Garage' smokes from T Outside block it.

callouts.name: Secret
callouts.look: Stairs down from the south-east of Outside into a narrow lower corridor that leads north to B site.
callouts.use: T route to B (lower level). CTs hold it from B or from Garage; Ts take it after winning Outside.

callouts.name: CT Spawn
callouts.look: Open yard at the east (radar right) with a curved wall and doors west into Lockers and Hell.
callouts.use: CT start. Short path to A through Lockers and Hell; Outside and Garage are reached across the yard.

callouts.name: B Site
callouts.look: Lower-level concrete room under A with hazard stripes, a big round object near the plant zone and doors to Ramp, Secret and the CT side.
callouts.use: Bomb site B (lower level, below A). Ramp and Secret are the T entries; CTs arrive by Back Stairs, Decon and Vents.

callouts.name: Decon
callouts.look: Small room at the south-west corner of the lower level, next to the corridor that leads to Secret.
callouts.use: CT hold covering Secret and the back of B; Ts clear it when entering from Secret.

callouts.name: Back Stairs
callouts.look: Stairway from Lockers down to the east side of B, with a small room overlooking the site.
callouts.use: CT rotation from the A side and CT spawn to B. Retakes on B often start here.

powerPositions.counter: Smoke Heaven (and Hell) before any A entry, or flash it while two players swing Hut and Squeaky together.

powerPositions.counter: Ts: take it with flashes from Radio and Trophy and trade in pairs. CTs: nade or molly it early, then fall back.

powerPositions.counter: Pre-aim it when entering from Hut or Squeaky; a flash over Hut clears it.

powerPositions.counter: Valve's Close Mini smoke from T Outside, then cross the yard.

powerPositions.counter: Valve's Garage and Far Garage smokes, or a full outside smoke wall.

powerPositions.counter: Flash down the stairs and molly Decon before walking the corridor.

powerPositions.counter: Molly Decon from the Secret corridor, then trade.

maps.spawns: T Spawn: far west (overview icon 0.19, 0.54). CT Spawn: east (icon 0.82, 0.45), a short walk to A through Lockers and Hell. B is reached from CT by Back Stairs or by dropping through Vents from A. Rotation times were not confirmed from a source this session.

modeTips.t: Outside take: Valve's official lineups from T Outside give a smoke wall (Close Mini, Garage, Far Garage and the 'Unbreakable' smoke); cross behind it, then go Secret for B or Mini for A. Lobby default: take Lobby, Trophy and Radio, win Ramp with flashes, keep info on Hut and Squeaky. A execute: smoke Heaven and Hell (and Mini if you do not own Outside), flash over Hut and Squeaky, then enter Hut, Squeaky and Mini together. B execute: Ramp and Secret at once; flash down Ramp, molly Decon, and use Vents if A is already yours.
modeTips.ct: Common setup: one Heaven, one on A floor or Mini, one or two Ramp, one Outside/Garage (often the AWP), one B (Decon or back of B). Early round: nade or molly Ramp and Squeaky to slow Lobby pushes; smoke Outside to deny a fast take. Rotate A to B through Vents (fast, one way) or Back Stairs; B to A through Back Stairs and Lockers.
modeTips.pistol: Ts: fast Lobby to Hut and Squeaky, or Ramp with five. CTs: two on Ramp and one Heaven stop most pistol rushes; molly the Squeaky door. Kevlar matters: buy it if you have the money.
modeTips.retake: A: Heaven and Hell together with a flash over the site; a Mini or Ramp player cuts T escape. B: drop Vents and push Back Stairs at the same time; smoke Ramp top so the post-plant cannot see the defuse.
modeTips.postplant: A: hold from Hut, Squeaky/Lobby and Outside towards Mini. B: hold from Ramp top and Secret/Decon; a molly on the default plant buys time. Listen for Vents drops. C4 blast damage was reworked in July 2026 (Season 5): re-check safe distances in practice.

maps.weaponFit: AWP on Outside (Garage, CT yard, T Roof) and down Ramp. Rifles for Ramp and A. SMGs and shotguns for Ramp, Secret, Hut and the lower level (short corridors). Height matters on A (Heaven, Hut Roof).
mistakes: Walking onto A without smoking or flashing Heaven
Forgetting B is below A: misreading sounds and calls
Crossing Outside without a smoke wall
Losing Ramp to a single CT and giving up B for free
CTs rotating to B on foot when Vents is faster
Not checking Hut Roof and Rafters on entry
Retaking B only through Back Stairs
Leaving Secret unwatched after Outside is lost

utilityPlans.name: A execute from T Roof and Lobby
utilityPlans.how: Roof players smoke Heaven, then burn Hut and Rafters and pop the A flash. Lobby players flash Hut and enter as the fires end. Check the glass first: the Heaven smoke needs it intact, and the roof molotovs need it broken.

utilityPlans.name: Outside take to Secret
utilityPlans.how: Throw Valve's Outside Smoke Wall and the Mini smoke so the team can cross Outside. Then smoke both ends of Secret from the Outside corner and drop to B together.

utilityPlans.name: Ramp push to B
utilityPlans.how: Burn the Ramp boxes, then smoke the bottom of Ramp at Hell. Push down Ramp as a group, and time it with a Secret player so B CTs face two sides.

utilityPlans.name: Retake A
utilityPlans.how: A player in Heaven smokes Hut so Lobby cannot feed in, then burns Squeaky. Flash from CT Spawn and retake through Main and Heaven at the same time.

utilityPlans.name: Retake B
utilityPlans.how: Retake from Ramp and Decon together. Smoke the double doors so Secret players cannot watch, and burn Dark before entering. These two lineups are not text-verified, so practise them first.

arsenal.name: Glock-18

stats.oneTapRange: helmet stops a one-shot (56); bare head one-shot within about 560 units

arsenal.summary: Default Terrorist pistol. Cheap, fast-firing and carries 20 rounds, but weak against armour; a helmet stops any one-shot headshot. Right-click toggles a 3-round burst for very close fights. On the pistol round most Terrorists keep it and buy armour or utility instead.
strengths: Free at spawn; good spray damage against unarmoured players
Burst mode can one-burst unarmoured heads up close
weaknesses: Poor at range: large damage fall-off
counters: Buy Kevlar + Helmet on the pistol round and fight at mid range
Take long angles where its fall-off hurts
Use the USP-S or P2000 head-height precision against it
tips: On pistol rounds rush together and trade; Glocks win by volume of fire, not single shots.
Aim at head height and tap; only spray when the enemy is very close.
Switch to burst only for corner fights inside about 5 metres.
arsenal.look: Kill feed: white side-on silhouette between the two names. Glock: short boxy pistol with a square slide. HUD ammo shows 20 when full; it is the pistol Terrorists spawn with.
arsenal.notes: Numbers from CS2 game data (build 2000935). One-shot ranges use the standard model: damage x rangeModifier^(distance/500); with armour, health damage = damage x armour ratio / 2. 1 unit is about 2.5 cm.

counters: Buy a helmet on the second round against CT pistols
Swarm it: 12 rounds struggle against several enemies
Close the distance fast where its slow fire rate matters

On the pistol round with no helmet on the Ts, every headshot kills.
Stop moving before each shot; counter-strafe for accuracy.
